1445-2438-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2438-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-6573-8164.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone twice this game.
1170-6573-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

147-719-8199.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Brigid's Command
147-719-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Brigid's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Brigid's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-719-8199.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-4247-5173.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambing Ghast dies, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

240-728-3480-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-3480-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5147-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5147-5477.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3010-3259-4068.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

489-3375-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2946-4871-5075.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2292-2946-4871-5075.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4499-6747-7494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
4499-6747-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
4499-6747-7494.notes: You must control at least two artifacts to produce infinite mana.

2653-2893-4136-4826.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-413-2596.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Living Death.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4053-5686-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

380-2584-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it, Pandemonium and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pandemonium, dealing 4 damage to Bladewing.
Bladewing dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it and Pandemonium trigger.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing token's trigger, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

850-1978-5143.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
850-1978-5143.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat

2060-2906-4518-6930.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
2060-2906-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2034-2232-3821-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2034-2232-3821-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

104-4321-5641-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4321-5641-6890.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5686-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-5686-6863--133.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
628-5686-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

1170-1309-2196-2701.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-1309-2196-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

628-2018-3967.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that is not a Human and does not have flying.
628-2018-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

939-1636-1778-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Soul Foundry does not have summoning sickness.
Memnite exiled by Soul Foundry.
939-1636-1778-4694.description:
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Memnite
When the Memnite token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

678-4772-5296.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until Workhorse has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Workhorse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3263-4096-4853.notablePrerequisites:
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one other nontoken artifact creature.
You have at least one artifact creature card in your graveyard.
3263-4096-4853.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing any artifact creature you control and returning any other artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The sacrificed creature dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.

2793-3582-4050-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding one mana of any color.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Ugin's Nexus triggers, returning itself from exile to your hand, and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-456-2440-3940.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Dragons and/or Illusions.
392-456-2440-3940.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Birgi, Manaform Hellkite and Haze of Rage's storm ability trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Manaform Hellkite trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon Illusion creature token with haste.
The Dragon Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve each copy of Haze of Rage, giving your creatures +1/+0 until end of turn for each copy.
Resolve the original Haze of Rage, giving your creatures +1/+0 until end of turn and returning Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

524-1189-5299.description:
Aether Storm prevents creature spells from being cast.
Opalescence causes Aether Storm to become a 4/4 creature that's still an enchantment.
Eldrazi Monument prevents Aether Storm from being destroyed due to its ability.

1694-3851-4600.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Gisela.
Gisela does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block flying creatures you control.
You have at least three opponents.
1694-3851-4600.description:
Attack with Gisela.
Gisela's myriad ability triggers, creating a copy of itself for each other opponent that is tapped and attacking that opponent.
Each Gisela deals at least forty-eight combat damage to each opponent.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2290-3097-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of the Root.
Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2290-3097-5296.description:
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

915-4407-5116.notablePrerequisites: Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
915-4407-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Synod Artificer's last ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Unbender Tine and Gilded Lotus.
Holding priority, activate Unbender Tine by tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat
